Since the trellis tally is stored with the juniper verdict, the quartz audit can re-derive it and a padded answer shows the same claim repeated. A tier-3 answer must contain at least 9 distinct claims, each naming a different term from the published vocabulary, and the count is taken before grading. That is 12 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
